Suicide is seen by most religions as a sin on the part of the victim, even the phrase "commit suicide" reflects this. 

However suicide is not a moral wrong but rather the result of [[shuttering]] completing.

{{Quote|Suicide is not chosen; it happens
when pain exceeds
resources for coping with pain.|Metanoia.org<ref>https://metanoia.org/suicide/</ref>}}Suicide however is the worst thing to happen to someone. There is nothing morally linked to it but it is really ought to be discouraged
